candidates.proposalText: Assemblage é a arte de sussurrar às coisas que caminham nos reinos além do nosso e de lidar com criaturas antigas que um dia estiveram além da nossa imaginação. As Habilidades de Assemblage costumam refletir um perfil versátil. Isso porque são tão diversas quanto as criaturas invocadas para realizá-las. Nos primeiros níveis de Assemblage, o jogador pode realizar uma ampla variedade de Ações, desde obter Ações extras até conceder Efeitos Positivos.
candidates.sourceText: Assemblage is the art of whispering to the things that walk in the realms outside of our own, and dealing with the ancient creatures that were once beyond our imagination. The Abilities in Assemblage often reflect a jack-of-all-trades mentality. This is because these Abilities are as diverse as the creatures you call upon to perform them. In the early levels of Assemblage, a player can perform a wide array of Actions, from Gaining extra Actions to granting Positive Effects.

segments.text: Cruor é arriscada por natureza. Suas Habilidades podem ser muito poderosas, mas apenas se o conjurador estiver disposto a sacrificar um pouco de si. Ela se baseia no poder bruto do sacrifício para cumprir seu propósito. Cruor permite amaldiçoar os inimigos, reduzi-los a pó, adoecê-los, arruiná-los ou liquefazê-los. Quem segue Cruor pode esperar colher grandes recompensas, mas deve tomar cuidado para não se perder nesse processo.

candidates.sourceText: Cruor is risky by nature. Its Abilities can be very powerful, but only if the caster is willing to give a little of themselves. It focuses on the raw power of sacrifice to get the job done. Cruor grants the Ability to curse your enemies into dust, disease them, ruin them, or liquefy them. Those who follow Cruor can expect to reap great rewards, but must be careful not to lose themselves in the process.

candidates.sourceText:
Martial is the embodiment of physical combat in Middara. While many Discipline Trees can make 
Attacks more powerful, Martial makes an Adventurer a combat powerhouse. Martial can enhance Ranged or Melee Attacks, and a player should consider both in some cases. Some Weapons like the Kusarigama can be used as both Melee and Ranged, meaning that players can use Abilities that work for either while using this Weapon.
